decisions.reason: Report correctly ties the plugin's top-level ESM import to the boot log's single classic-script combo and the browser compile error: one syntax error kills the whole combo so no entry registers, and the stock typert-registry entry is identified as just the first awaited victim, with the real signal being the dsh-profiles bundle compile error at 1:1. It scopes the ESM problem to classic-script parsing, not all JS contexts.

Bisects the cordis.patch.yml insert rows and gives a cheap static check (grep for top-level import/export, classic-script parse) that flags the bundle; describes the loader load({id, factory}) wrapper, host React via require inside the factory, the CJS module.exports return, and the apply/inject exports, matching the working-plugin excerpt's packaging shell.

Correctly explains that another entry owns the settings.section declaration and a bare cross-entry register fails at apply, and that kind/scope are declaration-owned. But it never shows the precise deferred form ctx.slots.inject("settings.section", () => ctx.slots.register(...)) — only a bare mention of slots.inject — and it wrongly lists the slot name among fields the registrant must not pass, while the contract lets registrants supply name/id/order.

Grounded in host-boot-log/restart-notes: combo assembled once per boot, edits and hard refresh do not rebuild it, full stop/restart per iteration, taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F for the orphaned Windows tree, and EADDRINUSE explained as the old process holding the port, not a packaging defect; ends with refresh and plugin-list verification.

Proposes per-bundle classic-script compilation at startup/combo failure naming the owning plugin instead of the first awaited entry, plus pre-compose ESM/wrapper sanity checks and apply-time slot attribution; the authoring checklist covers the loader factory, host-provided React via require, apply/inject exports, deferred cross-entry slot injection, and restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: The report's affirmative advice consistently requires the classic-script wrapper, ctx.slots.inject for cross-entry slots, no kind/scope on the registrant, and full host restarts with taskkill; no bare-ESM, immediate-registration, or HMR-instead-of-restart recommendation appears, and ESM examples are only cited as the rejected failure cause.
